articles.title: Crypto vault deposits top $10 billion as lending risks draw regulatory scrutiny
articles.snippet: Curator-managed lending strategies are attracting institutional capital, while exposing depositors to collateral, liquidity and smart-contract risks.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Korea’s Kospi and Nasdaq futures rally as China GDP beats estimates
articles.snippet: Bitcoin, Nasdaq futures and Asian stocks rally as stronger-than-expected China GDP and falling oil prices lift risk appetite.

articles.title: Wall Street freaked out Friday, but VIX and bitcoin trades say the fear may fade Monday.
articles.snippet: Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index, spiked on Friday as stocks dropped. History says Friday panics usually fade on Monday. Seasonality and calm bitcoin markets suggest the same.

articles.title: Mastercard launches stablecoin risk screening for banks and payment providers
articles.snippet: The new service combines payment data and blockchain analytics to help banks detect suspicious stablecoin transactions before settlement.

articles.title: Metaplanet to take 93.7% stake in Super League through 2,100 BTC deal
articles.snippet: The transaction would give Metaplanet access to US capital markets, where it plans to use preferred stock offerings to finance additional Bitcoin purchases.
